text: Test redirect sanitizers against inputs that normalize to //host ('//x', '/\x', '/.//x', '/a/..//x', '%2F%2F'), not only literal ones; resolve with new URL(next, origin) and compare origins.
Re-check authentication, authorization scope and input in every Server Action; it is a public endpoint regardless of the page or layout that renders the form.
Guard each protected page (or the proxy), not only the layout; layouts do not re-run on every navigation and do not protect actions or route handlers.
React 19 resets uncontrolled forms after an action; on a validation error echo the typed values back (defaultValue from action state with a key, or controlled inputs), never the password.

source.finding: typed values lost after a validation error

text: Give every interactive element a 44px touch target, including Radix radio, checkbox, select and dropdown items and icon buttons, not just the main buttons.
Opening an AlertDialog from a DropdownMenuItem: preventDefault in onSelect or control the dialog outside the menu, and return focus to the trigger; otherwise it unmounts or leaves body inert.
Keep aria-live regions mounted and empty before the message appears; a region inserted together with its text is not announced.
